findings_snapshot.claim: MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000, so tax is 10x too large and checkoutTotal/invoiceLine inherit the error; change the divisor to 10000
MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so the discount is 10x too small and checkoutTotal inherits the error; change the divisor to 100
MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses qty > 10 so qty exactly 10 gets no bulk discount; use qty >= 10
MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 caps at Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1 instead of 50 percent rounded down, allowing discounts above the cap; use Math.min(discount, Math.floor(subtotal / 2))
MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 clamps to 98 instead of 99, so qty 99 becomes 98; use Math.min(99, ...)
MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds 3 cents instead of the fixed 30 cents; change + 3 to + 30
MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses Math.round so 150 cents yields 2 points instead of 1 full-100 point; use Math.floor
MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses cents > 1000 so an order of exactly 1000 cents fails the minimum; use cents >= 1000
MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 uses Math.min(100, ...) which caps the fee at 100 instead of enforcing at least 100; use Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05))
MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses Math.floor for the extra 500 g blocks so a started block is not charged (e.g. 1200 g gives 500 instead of 600); use Math.ceil(extra / 500)
MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 uses i <= rem so rem+1 shares get the extra cent and the array sums to total+1 when rem < n; use i < rem

MUST-FIX src/invoice.js:5 renders the sum amount+tax as one number, but the contract "label: amount+tax ... both in integer cents" specifies both values shown; return `${label}: ${amount}+${taxCents(amount, rateBp)}`
MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses `qty > 10` so a line of exactly 10 units gets no discount, violating the "10 or more" contract; change to `qty >= 10`
MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 caps at `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1` (e.g. 502 for subtotal 1001, 501 for 1000) instead of at most 50% rounded down; replace with `Math.min(discount, Math.floor(subtotal / 2))`
MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:4 clamps to `Math.min(98, ...)` so clampQty(99) returns 98, outside the required 1..99 range; change 98 to 99

MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, making every discount 10x too small (couponCents(1000, 50) = 50 instead of 500) and propagating wrong totals into src/checkout.js:7; change the divisor to 100
MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000, making tax 10x too large (taxCents(1000, 1000) = 1000 instead of 100) and corrupting checkoutTotal and invoiceLine; change the divisor to 10000
MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds a fixed 3 cents instead of the contracted 30; change `+ 3` to `+ 30`
MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses Math.round instead of rounding down, so pointsFor(150) returns 2 instead of 1 point per full 100 cents; use `Math.floor(cents / 100)` inside the Math.max(0, ...)
MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000` so a 1000-cent order fails the "at least 1000 cents" minimum; change to `cents >= 1000`

MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 computes the fee as `Math.min(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05))`, capping it at 100 instead of flooring it at 100 (refundCents(10000) = 9900 instead of 9500; refundCents(100) = 95 instead of 0); use `Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05))`

MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses `Math.floor(extra / 500)`, which misses a started 500 g block (shippingCents(1001) = 500 instead of 600, same through 1499); use `Math.ceil(extra / 500)` for the extra-block count

MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 uses `i <= rem` so rem+1 shares get an extra cent and the array sums to total + 1 (splitCents(10, 3) = [4,4,3] summing 11, and even rem = 0 adds a cent to the first share); change the condition to `i < rem`
MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 uses `qty > 10` but spec says "10 or more"; qty=10 misses the discount. Change to `qty >= 10`.
MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 uses `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1` instead of `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)`; over-caps every subtotal. Replace with `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)`.
MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 caps at 98 instead of 99; spec says range 1..99 inclusive. Change `Math.min(98,` to `Math.min(99,`.
MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, producing a discount 10× too small. Change `/1000` to `/100`.
MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds 3 instead of 30 for the fixed component. Change `+ 3` to `+ 30`.
MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses `Math.round` but spec requires round-down (floor). Change to `Math.floor`.
MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `> 1000` but spec says "at least 1000". Change to `>= 1000`.

MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4-5 caps the fee at 100 instead of flooring the refund at 100; spec says refund = paid − round(5%) but at least 100 cents, never below 0. Rewrite as `const fee = Math.round(paidCents * 0.05); return Math.max(0, Math.max(100, paidCents - fee));`.
MUST-FIX src/ship.js:5 uses `Math.floor(extra / 500)` but "each started additional 500 g" requires ceiling; e.g. 1001 g must cost 600 not 500. Change to `Math.ceil(extra / 500)`.
MUST-FIX src/split.js:5 condition `i <= rem` assigns one extra share; sum exceeds total by 1. Change to `i < rem`.
MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000 (basis points), inflating tax 10×. Change `/1000` to `/10000`.
